panels.title: Semantic Validation Issues
panels.description: Semantic issues detected by type.

panels.title: Security Events (HITL)
panels.description: Security events detected in HITL flows (DoS attempts, abuse, rate limits). Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: Auth Attempts
panels.description: Total authentication attempts.

panels.title: Circuit Breaker State (0=closed, 1=open, 2=half-open)
panels.description: Current circuit breaker state (0=closed, 1=open, 2=half_open).

panels.title: State Changes
panels.description: Total circuit breaker state changes.

panels.title: Calls through Breaker (by result)
panels.description: Total calls through circuit breaker.

panels.title: Open Duration (seconds)
panels.description: Time in seconds since circuit opened (0 if closed).

panels.title: HTTP 5xx Errors (by endpoint)
panels.description: Total HTTP errors by status code and exception type. Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: HTTP 4xx Client Errors (by type)
panels.description: Total HTTP 4xx client errors by specific type. Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: HTTP 5xx Server Errors (by type)
panels.description: Total HTTP 5xx server errors by specific type. Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: LLM API Errors (by provider)
panels.description: Total LLM API errors by provider and error type. Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: LLM Rate Limit Hits
panels.description: Total LLM rate limit hits by provider and limit type. Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: LLM Context Length Exceeded
panels.description: Total context length exceeded errors by provider and model.

panels.title: LLM Content Filter Violations
panels.description: Total content filter violations by provider. Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: External Service Errors
panels.description: Total external service errors by service and error type. Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: External Service Timeouts
panels.description: Total external service timeouts by service. Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: Validation Errors (by field)
panels.description: Total validation errors by field and error type. Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: Security Violations (by type)
panels.description: Total security violations by violation type. Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: Graph Exceptions
panels.description: Total exceptions in graph execution. Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: Usage Limit Checks (by result)
panels.description: Total usage limit checks performed.

panels.title: Usage Limit Enforcements (by layer/type)
panels.description: Total enforcement actions (user blocked from action).

panels.title: Tool module import failures
panels.description: Tool modules that failed to import at startup (prod swallows the error and counts it here — dev/CI raise). Any value > 0 means an entire tool family is silently missing from the registry.

panels.title: Import failures (by module)
panels.description: Tool-module import failures over time, by module. Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: Self-check verdicts
panels.description: Every self-check tick, by check and verdict. A check stuck on `unknown` is a blind spot (it caps the snapshot at degraded); `critical` opens an incident.

panels.title: Incidents opened
panels.description: Incidents opened by source (alert webhook vs self-check) and severity. One outage converges on ONE incident whichever observer saw it first.

panels.title: Self-check tick duration (p95)
panels.description: Engine + persistence + incident sync + diagnosis pump. The evidence collection (ADR-266) runs inside this tick: a source timing out shows here before it shows anywhere else.

panels.title: Diagnosis LLM spend (USD, cumulative)
panels.description: Cumulative USD spent on diagnosis LLM calls. The daily cap lives in DIAGNOSTICS_DIAGNOSIS_DAILY_COST_CAP_USD; the evidence pack (ADR-266) roughly triples the tokens of one call.

panels.title: Catalogue misses (escalation signal)
panels.description: Requests for a query the curated catalogue could not serve, by surface. The measured criterion for offering free-form PromQL/LogQL (spec §3): while this stays at 0, nobody needed it.

panels.title: Diagnosis evidence sources
panels.description: Sources read for each diagnosis, by source and status (ADR-266). A rising `unavailable` means the diagnostician reasons half-blind — check the circuit breaker of that telemetry source first.

panels.title: Pipeline components up
panels.description: Whether Prometheus scrapes each component of the observability pipeline. Alloy, Loki, Tempo and Grafana down for 10 minutes fire ObservabilityScrapeTargetMissing; Alertmanager down fires AlertmanagerDown.

panels.title: Log lines shipped and stored
panels.description: Lines Alloy sent and lines Loki received, per second. The two follow each other; a gap is lines lost on the way (next panel).

panels.title: Log lines lost
panels.description: Lines Alloy dropped once its retries ran out, and lines Loki refused, by reason — what LogsNotDelivered fires on (a refusal for age is not a loss: Alloy re-reads old lines after a positions reset). Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: Spans received and refused
panels.description: Spans Tempo received from the API and spans it refused, by reason, per second.

panels.title: Span metrics written to Prometheus
panels.description: Samples and exemplars Tempo's metrics generator remote-writes to Prometheus (dashboard 06's trace panels read them), and the ones that failed.

panels.title: Prometheus series and exemplars
panels.description: Series in Prometheus's head block, and exemplars held in its ring buffer (storage.exemplars.max_exemplars). Memory follows the series count.

panels.title: Loki streams in memory
panels.description: Streams Loki's ingester holds. Every label value is a stream: a climbing count is a label with open values (the cause of Loki's OOM kills in August 2026, held off by test_promtail_label_cardinality_guard.py).
